# Skia variable-font fixture

`RobotoMono-Variable.ttf` is the unmodified `RobotoMono[wght].ttf` from
[Google Fonts, ofl/robotomono](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/robotomono).
The accompanying `RobotoMono-OFL.txt` is its SIL Open Font License.

Source Git blob IDs:

- Font: `f21d1d716bce3cc756bc618d32be71ce6f733f81`
- License: `8e7df338d36eb52c49548ecc58afcb7eb3f73898`

The adapter test checks this font's weight axis at 100, 400 and 900. It does not
assert support for other fonts or variable-font axes.
